name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AuthFlowIT
comment: End-to-end AUTH flow against a real PostgreSQL with the Flyway schema and dev seed. Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: signInReturnsTokenAndUser
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-001: valid credentials return a token and the contract user shape.

methods.name: wrongPasswordAndUnknownEmailLookTheSame
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-002: wrong password and unknown email get the same generic answer.

methods.name: signOutRevokesToken
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-003: me works with the token; after sign-out the same token gets 401.

methods.name: roleRulesAreEnforced
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-004: no token → 401; a student calling an Admin endpoint → 403.

methods.name: accountLocksAfterMaxFailedAttempts
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-005 (boundary): the 5th wrong password locks the account, even for the right password.

methods.name: invalidBodyReturnsFieldErrors
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-006 (negative): body validation returns field messages.

methods.name: termsAreListed
methods.comment: TC-CFG-001: published Terms with string ids, ISO dates and the list total.

methods.name: forgotPasswordIsSilent
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-007: forgot password never reveals whether the email exists.

methods.name: rememberIsOptional
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-008: "remember" may be left out (Jackson 3 would reject a missing primitive).

methods.name: googleNeedsExactlyOneOfCodeAndCredential
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-009 (negative): Google sign-in needs exactly one of code and credential.

methods.name: googleDisabledWithoutConfiguration
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-010: without Google configuration both flows answer 503 GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.ModularityTests
comment: Fails the build when a module reaches into another module's internals or when modules depend on each other in a cycle (ADR-10). Also writes PlantUML module diagrams to target/spring-modulith-docs (use them in Report 4 §1.2).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PostgresTestcontainer
comment: One PostgreSQL 17 container for integration tests (needs Docker).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.auth.internal.GoogleCodeExchangerTest
comment: Google authorization-code exchange (ADR-14). Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: exchangesCodeForIdToken
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-011: the code is posted with the popup redirect URI and the ID token is returned.

methods.name: usedCodeIsInvalid
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-012 (negative): a used or expired code is the user's retryable error (401).

methods.name: wrongClientSecretIsUnavailable
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-013 (negative): a wrong client secret is our misconfiguration, not the user's (503).

methods.name: codeFlowNeedsClientSecret
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-015 (boundary): without a client secret the code flow is off and Google is never called.
